mapper.sql: SELECT record_id, record_no, template_id, ccp_name, monitor_type, route_id, process_name, work_order_no, wip_id, wip_no, batch_id, batch_code, material_id, material_code, material_name, record_time, temp_value, humidity_value, salt_rate, mold_status, monitor_value, limit_snapshot, judge_result, over_note, corrective, ncr_id, ncr_no, recorder, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark FROM food_ccp_record
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO food_ccp_record ( record_no, template_id, ccp_name, monitor_type, route_id, process_name, work_order_no, wip_id, wip_no, batch_id, batch_code, material_id, material_code, material_name, record_time, temp_value, humidity_value, salt_rate, mold_status, monitor_value, limit_snapshot, judge_result, over_note, corrective, recorder, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark )VALUES( #{recordNo}, #{templateId}, #{ccpName}, #{monitorType}, #{routeId}, #{processName}, #{workOrderNo}, #{wipId}, #{wipNo}, #{batchId}, #{batchCode}, #{materialId}, #{materialCode}, #{materialName}, #{recordTime}, #{tempValue}, #{humidityValue}, #{saltRate}, #{moldStatus}, #{monitorValue}, #{limitSnapshot}, #{judgeResult}, #{overNote}, #{corrective}, #{recorder}, '0', #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{remark} )
mapper.update: UPDATE food_ccp_record SET ncr_id = #{ncrId}, ncr_no = #{ncrNo}, update_time = NOW() WHERE record_id = #{recordId}
mapper.select: SELECT CONCAT('CCP', DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d'), LPAD(IFNULL(MAX(CAST(RIGHT(r.record_no, 4) AS UNSIGNED)), 0) + 1, 4, '0')) FROM food_ccp_record r WHERE r.record_no LIKE CONCAT('CCP', DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d'), '%')
